About Us

Observe.AI is the AI Agents platform for customer experience, designed to help organizations deliver faster, smarter, and more efficient customer service at scale. The platform enables businesses to deploy specialized AI agents that autonomously execute work across the full CX lifecycle—from handling customer conversations to supporting frontline teams and optimizing operations.

Each AI agent is purpose-built for a specific role, equipped to understand context, make decisions, take action, and continuously improve outcomes. This allows organizations to increase resolution speed, elevate service quality, and reduce operational costs while empowering your frontline team to focus on higher-value work.

Built on a CX-native foundation, Observe.AI works with 300+ global brands in Financial Services, Insurance, Healthcare and Consumer Services, including brands like DoorDash, Affordable Care, to improve customer satisfaction, boost productivity, and deliver consistent, scalable performance across every customer interaction.

Why Join Us

As a GSI Partner Lead at Observe.AI, you will play a hands-on role in building and scaling our Global System Integrator (GSI) partner ecosystem. This is an individual contributor role for a partnership professional who can operate in a 0→1 environment, build programs from the ground up, and turn strategic partnerships into measurable pipeline and revenue.

You will work closely with the leadership team across Strategic Alliances, Sales, Marketing, Product and Customer Success to establish relationships with leading GSIs, develop joint go-to-market motions, enable partner teams, and create the infrastructure required to scale the program.

This is not a traditional partner coordination role. We are looking for someone who can roll up their sleeves, create the playbook, engage directly with partners, solve problems independently, and build a repeatable GSI business.

What You’ll Be Doing

Build & Scale GSI Partnerships

  • Build GSI partnerships from 0→1, including identifying target partners, developing relationships, defining engagement models and establishing joint business plans.
  • Develop and execute a GSI partner strategy aligned to Observe.AI's revenue and market expansion objectives.
  • Build relationships with senior stakeholders across GSIs such as Accenture, Infosys, Genpact, TCS, Wipro and similar global consulting and system integration organizations.
  • Identify opportunities to expand partner relationships across geographies, accounts and solution areas.
  • Establish the operating rhythm, governance, KPIs and processes required to scale the GSI program.

Drive Joint Go-to-Market & Revenue

  • Develop joint GTM motions with GSI partners that generate qualified pipeline and revenue.
  • Identify target accounts and opportunities where the partner can influence, originate or accelerate Observe.AI business.
  • Work closely with Sales teams to develop joint account strategies and drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities.
  • Build and execute partner enablement programs including sales training, product demonstrations, workshops and solution positioning.
  • Create partner-facing business cases, pitch materials, solution collateral and other assets required to activate the ecosystem.
  • Track partner pipeline, revenue contribution, engagement and other KPIs, using data to identify gaps and improve performance.

Be Hands-On with Partners

  • Act as a day-to-day business owner for assigned GSI relationships rather than relying on internal teams to execute partnership activities.
  • Conduct partner meetings, workshops, enablement sessions and business reviews.
  • Be comfortable demonstrating products, explaining value propositions and helping partners position Observe.AI with their customers.
  • Proactively identify and remove blockers across Sales, Marketing, Product and other internal teams.
  • Build relationships across multiple levels of the partner organization, from practitioners and delivery teams to sales leaders and executives.

Build the Partnership Playbook

  • Develop repeatable frameworks for partner onboarding, enablement, opportunity identification, deal registration, pipeline tracking and joint business planning.
  • Establish dashboards and reporting to measure partner performance and ROI.
  • Document learnings and continuously improve the GSI engagement model.
  • Help define the broader channel strategy as the Observe.AI partner ecosystem scales.

What You'll Bring To The Role

  • 6–10 years of experience in strategic partnerships, alliances, channel sales, business development or partner management.
  • Demonstrated experience building a GSI, channel or strategic partner program from scratch, preferably in a startup, scale-up or high-growth technology company.
  • Proven experience working directly with Global System Integrators such as Genpact, Infosys, Cognizant, TCS, Wipro, Capgemini or similar organizations.
  • A track record of converting partnerships into pipeline, revenue or measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of partner-led GTM, co-selling, partner enablement, joint account planning and channel development.
  • Experience creating partnership frameworks, playbooks, enablement programs and operating mechanisms rather than simply managing an established program.
  • Strong commercial orientation with the ability to understand revenue targets, pipeline, partner contribution and business economics.
  • Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to engage with both operational teams and senior executives.
  • Strong executive presence, professional body language and the ability to build credibility quickly with external partners.
  • Hands-on, self-starter mindset with a strong bias toward action and the ability to unblock yourself without depending heavily on other teams.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and building structure where processes do not yet exist.
  • Demonstrated grit, resilience and ownership, with a strong desire to build and win.
  • Experience in AI, SaaS, CCaaS, Contact Center, Conversational AI or enterprise technology is strongly preferred.
  • Willingness to travel as required for partner meetings, customer engagements and industry events.

Perks & Benefits

  • Comprehensive medical insurance coverage for self and family, including free online doctor consultations and additional wellness benefits
  • Accidental insurance and group term life insurance coverage
  • Privilege and sick leave in line with applicable statutory norms
  • Generous national and festive holidays, along with well-defined parental leave policies
  • Annual Learning & Development allowance to support continuous professional growth
  • Rewards and recognition programs designed to encourage and celebrate high performance
  • Regular team and culture-building events across the organization
  • Flexible benefits for tax optimisation, including meal cards, provident fund, and other options

Our Commitment to Inclusion and Belonging

Observe.AI is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. Observe AI does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual …

Headquarters: United States (Remote)

Founded in 2018 with co-headquarters in Dublin and Boston, Tines powers some of the world's most important workflows. Our intelligent workflow platform applies AI, automation, and integration with human ingenuity to drive real business results. 

Tines serves a diverse range of customers, from startups to public companies, including Canva, Databricks, Elastic, Kayak, Intercom, and McKesson. As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor-agnostic integrating with any API-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest-priority goals faster. And because Tines is secure and private by design, it’s popular with security, IT, engineering, finance, and other security-focused teams.

At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.
This is a remote position that must be based in PST or MST.

Role Overview

As a Lead Customer Success Manager, you will own the post-sales strategic relationship, retention, and value realization across our highest-stakes enterprise accounts. You are a self-starter and bar-raiser who operates with high autonomy, driving customer outcomes while working in tight partnership with Sales to uncover and capitalize on strategic growth opportunities.

In this role, you will serve as the trusted advisor and strategic lead for your portfolio, orchestrating technical and commercial counterparts—including Forward-Deployed Engineers (FDEs), Account Executives, and Product leaders. You will bridge complex technical deployments with executive-level business goals, ensuring customers realize maximum value from their investment and naturally expand their footprint with us.

Key Responsibilities

• Drive Strategic Account Value & Retention: Accountable for net retention, customer health, and long-term strategic alignment across a portfolio of complex enterprise accounts.

• Partner with Sales for Account Growth: Work side-by-side with Account Executives/Strategic Account Managers to identify expansion vectors, co-develop account plans, and position new capabilities that directly support the customer's technical roadmap.

• Integrate with Technical Counterparts: Partner closely with Forward-Deployed Engineers (FDEs) and technical leads to ensure technical delivery aligns directly with the client's business outcomes, removing friction and accelerating time-to-value.

• Operate as an Independent Bar-Raiser: Proactively build scalable Customer Success playbooks, elevate executive engagement standards, and operate with extreme ownership without needing step-by-step guidance.

• Cultivate C-Suite & Technical Sponsorship: Build multi-threaded relationships across business and technology functions (CIO, CISO, CTO, VPs of Engineering, Product Leads) to ensure continuous alignment with top corporate initiatives.

• Drive Business Outcomes & QBRs: Shift client conversations from product usage to business impact, leading executive business reviews (EBRs/QBRs) that demonstrate clear ROI and anchor the account for long-term growth.

Qualifications & Requirements

• Post-Sales Strategic Track Record: 10+ years in Enterprise Customer Success, Account Management, or Technical Account Management handling high-ARR, complex enterprise platforms.

• Commercial Acumen & Growth Mindset: Proven history of partnering with Sales to identify, nurture, and help close upsells, expansions, and renewals in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.

• Technical & FDE Alignment: Deep experience collaborating with Forward-Deployed Engineers, Solutions Architects, and product delivery teams to translate technical achievements into commercial value.

• High Autonomy & Leadership: Self-motivated bar-raiser with a bias for action who excels in ambiguous, fast-paced environments and takes full accountability for account outcomes.

• Executive Presence: Outstanding communication and presentation skills, with a track record of challenging and advising C-level executives on technology strategy and operational efficiency.

Nice-to-Haves / Pluses

• High Tech Industry Expertise: Domain knowledge in High Tech (e.g., cloud native, hardware/software OEMs, or AI/ML platforms) and an understanding of how engineering-led enterprises operate and scale.

What Success Looks Like in Year 1

• Month 3: Fully onboarded, account health assessments completed, and tight alignment established with assigned Sales AEs and FDE teams on key accounts.

• Month 6: Value-realization frameworks and executive cadence active across all accounts, with clear expansion pipelines co-developed alongside Sales.

• Month 12: High Net Retention Rate (NRR) achieved across the portfolio, demonstrable business outcomes delivered with FDEs, and elevated CS playbooks established as standard practice for the broader team.

Target Annual Earnings (salary + commission): $190K-220K OTE

Applicants for this opportunity must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

#LI-SW1

At Tines, we’re all about trying new things and taking the leap. If you’re second-guessing your application, we hope you’ll trust your gut and take the leap too! Applying for a new job isn’t always easy, especially if you’re thinking of a career pivot – but we’re big believers in learning and growth here at Tines, so you’ve nothing to worry about. A variety of experience, perspectives, and voices makes us the company we are. We’d love to hear from you.

Tines provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to sex, race, colour, ethnic or social origin, genetic features, language, religion or belief, political or any other opinion, membership of a national minority, property, birth, disability, age or sexual orientation.

SimpleTiger is seeking a strategic, data-driven Senior PPC Manager to lead paid media strategy and execution for our B2B SaaS clients. This role is ideal for a seasoned performance marketer with 5+ years of hands-on experience building, managing, and optimizing multi-channel paid advertising campaigns.

The Senior PPC Manager will own campaign performance across Google Ads, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram; translate client growth objectives into effective paid media strategies; and deliver clear, proactive communication and recommendations. You will work closely with our SEO, content, design, sales, and product teams to maximize qualified pipeline, customer acquisition, and return on ad spend for a portfolio of SaaS clients.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and lead comprehensive paid media strategies tailored to each client’s growth stage, business model, target audience, sales cycle, and revenue goals.

• Independently build, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.

• Own campaign setup from end to end, including keyword research, audience strategy, account and campaign structure, ad group development, bid strategies, conversion tracking, budget allocation, and ad creative direction.

• Monitor and optimize campaigns against core performance metrics, including CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, conversion rate, pipeline contribution, ROAS, and ROI.

• Develop and manage testing roadmaps for ad copy, creative, landing pages, offers, audiences, bidding strategies, and campaign structures.

• Analyze performance data to identify trends, diagnose issues, uncover growth opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations.

• Partner with content and design teams to develop high-performing ad creative and messaging that resonates with B2B SaaS buyers.

• Collaborate with the SEO team to ensure PPC strategies complement broader organic search, content, and demand-generation initiatives.

• Manage paid media budgets responsibly, making informed recommendations on spend allocation, scaling opportunities, and efficiency improvements.

• Work directly with clients to communicate performance, explain strategy, set expectations, and provide timely, proactive updates and recommendations.

• Lead client-facing reporting and performance discussions, turning complex campaign data into clear business insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Partner with sales and product stakeholders to align campaign targeting, messaging, and conversion goals with customer insights and business priorities.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with platform representatives to access platform support, strategic guidance, beta opportunities, and new features.

• Stay current on paid media platform updates, privacy and tracking changes, B2B SaaS advertising trends, and emerging best practices.

• Contribute to the continued improvement of SimpleTiger’s PPC processes, reporting frameworks, account standards, and strategic playbooks.

• Provide mentorship, strategic guidance, and quality assurance support to junior team members as the PPC function grows.

Requirements

• 5+ years of hands-on experience managing and optimizing PPC and paid social campaigns, ideally in B2B SaaS, an agency, or a high-growth technology environment.

• Proven experience managing substantial budgets across Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads, with required experience in Meta Ads Manager (Facebook and Instagram).

• Deep expertise in Google Ads, including Search, Display, YouTube, remarketing, Performance Max, conversion tracking, and automated bidding strategies.

• Strong working knowledge of LinkedIn and Meta advertising, including audience development, retargeting, lead-generation campaigns, and full-funnel B2B campaign strategy.

• Demonstrated success improving paid-media performance through structured testing, strategic budget allocation, ongoing optimization, and rigorous performance analysis.

• Experience launching campaigns from scratch and owning paid-media accounts from audit and strategy through execution, reporting, and continuous optimization.

• Proficiency with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, and comparable analytics, attribution, and reporting tools.

• Experience using AI-enabled tools and advertising-platform automation to improve campaign analysis, creative development, workflow efficiency, and optimization—while applying sound judgment to validate outputs and recommendations.

• Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation platforms, preferably HubSpot, and with B2B SaaS funnel metrics including lead quality, MQLs, SQLs, pipeline, CAC, LTV, and revenue attribution.

• Strong analytical, written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex performance data into clear, actionable recommendations for clients and internal stakeholders.

• Highly organized, self-directed, and detail-oriented, with the judgment and accountability to manage multiple client accounts in a remote, results-driven environment.

• Google Ads and Meta Blueprint certifications preferred, but not required.

Compensation & Benefits

• 100% remote work environment

• Results-oriented work environment

• Flexible working hours and vacation policy

• Company-provided computer for all team members

• All typical U.S. holidays observed with full paid time off

• Health insurance through the JustWorks HR platform

• 401(k) through Vestwell

You'll work across our D2C book of business — UNTUCKit, American Eagle, and others — running the analyses that drive merchandising, media mix, and lifecycle decisions. You'll do it AI-natively: notebooks, agents, LLMs in the loop, and a point of view on where agentic commerce is taking the category. This isn't a dashboard role. You'll own the full arc from raw data → EDA → models → recommendations → measured lift. Your work shows up in customer QBRs, in our product, and in the decisions iWorkers make every day. **What You'll Do Analytics & Modeling** Run market basket analysis, cohort analysis, RFM segmentation, and CLV modeling on Shopify and warehouse data. Build attribution models — MTA, MMM-lite, and incrementality tests that tie ad spend to revenue at the SKU and audience level. Build predictive models like propensity, churn, and next-best-action for D2C lifecycle programs. Design and analyze A/B tests and holdouts for paid media, email/SMS, and on-site personalization. Notebooks & EDA Live in Jupyter / Colab / Hex / Claude Code. Build reproducible notebooks that engineers and PMs can read and ship from. Pull from Shopify, BigQuery, Snowflake, GA4, Klaviyo, and ad platforms — clean, model, visualize, narrate. Turn EDA into one-page customer-facing insights not 40-slide decks. AI-Native Approach Use LLMs and agentic workflows as part of your daily toolkit — code generation, data exploration, hypothesis testing, narrative writing. Build evaluators and feedback loops for iCustomer's iWorkers (our role-based digital twins) on D2C use cases. Push the boundary on what an AI-native data scientist looks like in 2026. Agentic Commerce Develop a POV on where agentic commerce is heading — AI shopping agents, agent-to-agent purchase flows, conversational commerce, and what it means for D2C brands. Help shape iCustomer's roadmap for serving D2C brands in the agentic commerce era. Customer Impact Embed with our D2C customers' growth and analytics teams. Translate their messy data into clear decisions. Co-author case studies and Substack posts with the founder when the work is good enough to show. **Who You Are** 2–6 years as a Data/Decision Scientist, Marketing Data Scientist, or Marketing/Analytics Analyst at a D2C brand, ecommerce platform, agency, or martech company. Shopify fluency — you know the data model (orders, line items, customers, variants, draft orders) and the quirks. You've worked with Shopify Plus, Shop Pay, or the Storefront API. Strong in Python (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels) and SQL (BigQuery or Snowflake preferred). Hands-on with attribution and incrementality — MTA, MMM, geo-experiments, holdout design. Comfortable with the modern D2C stack: GA4, Klaviyo, Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads, Northbeam / Triple Whale, Segment / RudderStack. AI-native you use Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or similar as part of how you work, not as a novelty. Strong written communicator. You can turn a model output into a recommendation a CMO can act on. Curious about agentic commerce, agent-to-agent transactions, and conversational shopping you've at least read and thought about it. **Bonus Points** Curious about building SLMs (Small Language Models) — fine-tuning, distillation, RAG, evaluation. We'd love to give you a sandbox. Experience with dbt, Airflow / Prefect / Dagster, or modern data stack tooling. Built causal inference models (DoWhy, EconML, CausalImpact, synthetic control). Worked with CDPs or identity resolution (Segment, Bloomreach, Hightouch or open source tools) Published a notebook, blog post, or talk on D2C analytics or AI-native data work. B2B SaaS or B2B GTM analytics experience as a complement to D2C. **Logistics** Location: Bangalore-based, remote with hybrid work expected (in-person collaboration days at the Bangalore hub). Hours: Meaningful overlap with US Eastern Time (~5 hours daily minimum, including customer-facing calls).
